title: Quick
description: Fastest, for computers with 4 GB of memory or less. Good for proofreading and short rewrites.
source: Qwen3 1.7B by the Qwen team (Alibaba Cloud)

title: Balanced
description: Better writing, summaries and translation; needs about 4 GB of free memory.
source: Qwen3 4B by the Qwen team (Alibaba Cloud)

title: Best
description: Most capable, but slower without a graphics card; needs about 7 GB of free memory.
source: Qwen3 8B by the Qwen team (Alibaba Cloud)
